name: @tomgrv/vps-coder
description: Coder (remote development environments) with in-cluster PostgreSQL

CODER_ACCESS_URL.description: Externally reachable URL of Coder (default: http://coder.<wildcard domain>)

CODER_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the first Coder admin (default: admin@<wildcard domain>)

CODER_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first Coder admin (default: generated and saved)

CODER_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username of the first Coder admin

CODER_CHART_VERSION.description: Pin the Coder chart version (e.g. 2.37.4 stable); empty = latest

CODER_DB_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password for Coder (default: generated and saved)
